facts.fact: The state digital operator (ADIE, now Senegal Numerique SA) states it runs a public key infrastructure issuing electronic certificates to all users of the Senegalese administration, and a government security portal and CSIRT for the administrative intranet; the page has no date, so 2022 is taken from its footer copyright.

ADIE states its own security directorate and a central CSIRT team of ADIE members run the administrative intranet's incident response and the key management infrastructure; the page has no date, so 2022 is taken from its footer copyright.

systems.platform: incident response team for the administrative intranet
